title: Check against something that doesn't assume the answer
statement: Check what a machine made against something that doesn't assume the answer.
example: A transcriber given the script passed takes that began with extra speech; one given nothing caught all four.
detail:
Finding 6 and "What kept going wrong" in the film study (`othello-unit-video/research/FINDINGS.md`): a voice model read
its style instructions aloud at the start of all four takes. A transcriber given the script passed them; one not given
it caught one; Whisper, run with no prompt, caught all four. A fidelity score built on a recogniser's transcript put a
word-perfect film at 98.4% (`othello-unit-video/.claude/skills/uvk-video-compare/SKILL.md`), and a frame check that
matched file names passed a repaint whose picture had changed.
against: A later run found: one review of 30 AP items, itself done by a model, found the writer model's own scores reasonable and blamed a broken pass threshold rather than lenient self-grading (`icloud-work/ap-social-studies-generator/docs/archive/CLAUDE_MANUAL_REVIEW.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`icloud-work/incept/sat-reading-generation/sat-prompts.json`).
